_about: Recorded cues for tools/audio/cut_cc0.py (format from Crab Breeze, unchanged). A layer is {src: 'pack:file'} or {synth: '<gen_sfx layer or cue>'}, with optional shot (n-th shot of a multi-shot take), start, dur (s), pitch (tape-speed ratio), gain (dB after the layer is peak-normalised), lp, hp (Hz, steep), fadein, fadeout, delay (s), repeat. A cue may set len, drive (tanh), hp, lp (gentle, 12 dB/octave), distance (compressor, lowpass and reverb that push a bed into the background), loop, stereo, group, peak_db, what and edits. A cue whose what ends in (loops) loops in the game. A cue may also set scatter: a list of groups, each placing count short sounds picked from pick (layer specs) at seeded times inside within seconds (from 0, no closer than min_gap), with gain, pitch ranges and a pan width; scattered sounds are mixed after the distance treatment (this repository, 2026-11-06). A cue's lp_order (default 2, 12 dB/octave) makes its lp steeper: 4 is Crab Breeze's sealed-cockpit filter (two 2-pole passes at 4 kHz), used here for every weapon heard from the bridge through the hull, written 6 dB down (peak_db -7) (2026-11-07). A cue's hp_order (default 2) makes its hp steeper, as lp_order does its lp. Added in Pale Blue Dot (2026-11-14): takes, a list of objects, each merged over the cue's first layer (or over the cue when it has its own layers), writing <name>_1, <name>_2, ... (a footstep or a dig has several takes and the game picks one); group is this game's (Steps, Ground, Water, Weather, Craft, Fishing, Fauna, Menu, Ambience); every source is CC0 or public domain by its own page (a Freesound sound is freesound/<id>:<id>.mp3).

step_stone.what: A boot on stone, rock or ore: hard and short, with a little grit under the sole.
step_stone.edits: Kenney's concrete steps, take 6 is take 2 a tone lower; a shot of boots on gravel under each, high passed at 1.5 kHz, 12 dB down

step_dirt.what: A boot on soil or dirt: a soft, dull thud.

step_grass.what: A boot in grass: a soft thud and a brush of blades.
step_grass.edits: Kenney's grass steps; take 6 is take 4 a little higher; trimmed to the step and its brush

step_dry.what: A boot on dry grass and leaves: crisp and crackling.
step_dry.edits: Six steps from a walk in sneakers on dry leaves, each from its onset

step_sand.what: A boot in sand: a soft crunch and a hiss of grains.
step_sand.edits: Six steps from a recording of gritty sand steps, each from its onset

step_snow.what: A boot in snow: a packed squeak and crunch.
step_snow.edits: Kenney's snow steps and one heavy snow step from Freesound

step_wood.what: A boot on a town's floor, stair or deck: a hollow knock.
step_wood.edits: Kenney's wood steps with a step on hollow wood under each, 9 dB down; take 6 the hollow wood alone

step_shallow.what: Wading under the knees: a splash with each step.
step_shallow.edits: Six steps from a walk through shallow water, each from its onset

step_wet.what: The wet layer under a step on wet dirt, grass or stone: a squelch.
step_wet.edits: Three steps from a walk on muddy, wet ground

land_stone.edits: the family's step twice, 25 ms apart and lower, over Kenney's soft heavy impact

dig_stone.what: A pick into stone, rock or ore, three times a block: a hard metal clink and chips.

dig_dirt.what: A spade into soil or dirt: a gritty scrape and thud.
dig_dirt.edits: three spade strokes from a recording of digging a hole

dig_grass.what: A spade through turf: the dirt stroke and a rip of roots and grass.
dig_grass.edits: spade strokes with Kenney's grass steps 6 dB under for the rip

dig_dry.what: A spade into dry grass: the stroke and a crackle of dry stems.
dig_dry.edits: spade strokes 3 dB down under steps in dry leaves

dig_sand.what: A spade into sand: a soft, hissing scoop.
dig_sand.edits: two spade strokes in wet coarse sand and one scoop of sand by hand

dig_snow.what: A spade into packed snow: a crunching bite.
dig_snow.edits: three strokes of a metal shovel into icy snow

dig_wood.what: An axe into a wooden block: a dry chop.
dig_wood.edits: a single chop and two from an axe chopping wood

break_snow.what: A snow block coming out: a soft collapse.

break_wood.what: A wooden block coming out: a split and a creak.
break_wood.edits: a log split and Kenney's creak 8 dB down

water_enter_small.what: Slipping into water at a walk: a light splash.

water_enter_big.what: Falling or diving into water: a big plunge.
water_enter_big.edits: a big water splash with our sub boom's first half second 12 dB under

water_exit.what: Climbing out of the water: a lift and water running off.
water_exit.edits: the tail of a jump into water, a little faster, and a small splash 8 dB down

swim_stroke.what: An arm stroke at the surface: a scoop and a wash.
swim_stroke.edits: three strokes from a recording of swimming

swim_stroke_under.what: A stroke under water: the same scoop, dull and close.
swim_stroke_under.edits: swimming strokes low passed at 700 Hz, 24 dB/octave

bubbles.what: Breath escaping under water: a burble of bubbles.

breath.what: Surfacing after a long time under: a sharp breath in.

cast_whoosh.what: Casting: the rod's whoosh and the line running out.
cast_whoosh.edits: a fishing rod cast, as recorded

float_plop.what: The float landing on water: a small plop.
float_plop.edits: a water splash sped up 1.4 times and cut short

float_dry.what: The float landing on dry ground: a light tap.

nibble_tick.what: A fish nibbling: the float ticks on the surface.
nibble_tick.edits: the first 0.18 s of a splash, sped up 1.8 times

bite_splash.what: A bite: the float pulled under with a splash.

reel_loop.what: Reeling in: the reel's clicking whirr (loops).
reel_loop.edits: four seconds from the middle of a fly reel winding slowly, looped

line_snap.what: The line breaking: a sharp twang.

catch_splash.what: The fish pulled out of the water: a thrashing splash.

rotor_loop.what: A Kestrel rotor turning: a steady chop (loops; pitch follows rotor speed).
rotor_loop.edits: six seconds of a Bell 407 helicopter in steady flight, looped

nacelle_motor.what: The Kestrel's nacelles tilting: a geared electric whine (loops).
nacelle_motor.edits: the steady middle of one servo motor run, looped

airframe_wind.what: Air rushing over the airframe, louder with airspeed (loops).
airframe_wind.edits: eight seconds of cold arctic wind, high passed at 200 Hz, looped

hull_water.what: Water rushing past a hull under way, louder with speed (loops).
hull_water.edits: eight seconds of a rowing boat's wake, looped

bow_splash.what: The bow meeting a wave: a slap and spray.

sail_luff.what: A sail luffing: canvas flapping in the wind (loops).
sail_luff.edits: five seconds of flapping fabric, looped

sail_fill.what: A sail filling: one deep whump of canvas.
sail_fill.edits: one flap of a flag, slowed to 0.8

rigging_creak.what: Rigging and timbers creaking as the boat heels.
rigging_creak.edits: a liner's mooring hawsers creaking and two of Kenney's creaks, slowed

sheet_run.what: The sheet running out through a block: a rope's rattle.

paddle_stroke.what: A canoe paddle stroke: a dip and a swirl.
paddle_stroke.edits: three strokes of a canoe paddle

oar_stroke.what: An oar stroke: a creak of the rowlock and a pull through the water.
oar_stroke.edits: three strokes from a recording of oars rowing

hull_lap.what: Water lapping against a hull at rest (loops).
hull_lap.edits: ten seconds of water lapping against a boat, looped

water_slosh.what: Water sloshing in the bottom of the hull.

thruster_loop.what: Free flight's thruster: a steady jet roar, louder with thrust (loops).
thruster_loop.edits: a rocket boost loop with a thrust loop 6 dB under

rain_hit_water.what: Rain falling on the sea near the listener: a fine patter on water (loops).
rain_hit_water.edits: eight seconds of light rain, high passed at 600 Hz, looped

thunder_crack.what: A strike under 400 m: a tearing crack and the boom on top of it.
thunder_crack.edits: two close strikes, each with our sub boom 6 dB under it

thunder_close.what: A strike 400 m to 1.5 km off: a sharp clap and a roll.
thunder_close.edits: a close-up thunder clap and a thunderclap, each cut to its clap and roll

thunder_roll.what: A strike past 1.5 km: a long, low roll.
thunder_roll.edits: three distant thunders, low passed at 2.5 kHz; the first with our sub roll 8 dB under

strike_hit_tree.what: Lightning hitting a tree within 400 m: a crack, wood splitting, a sizzle.
strike_hit_tree.edits: the first 2.5 s of a close strike, a log split and a steam hiss under it

strike_hit_ground.what: Lightning hitting the ground within 400 m: a crack and a thud of earth.
strike_hit_ground.edits: the first 2.5 s of a close strike, a rock smash, and our sub boom

fire_crackle.what: A fire burning: crackles and the flame's roar, level by its size (loops).
fire_crackle.edits: twelve seconds of a crackling fire, looped

fire_hiss.what: Rain on a fire: steam hissing, louder as the rain hits harder (loops).
fire_hiss.edits: two seconds of steam at its fullest, looped

fire_out.what: A fire going out: a last puff of steam and a pop.
fire_out.edits: a short steam hiss and one crackle from the fire recording

owl.what: An owl at night, placed 30 to 200 m off at random: a soft hoot.

gull.what: A gull over a beach or the sea, placed 30 to 200 m off: one cry.
gull.edits: a single gull call and two from a gull on a beach

dog_far.what: A dog barking somewhere in a town, placed 30 to 200 m off.

amb_wind_low.what: A soft breeze near the ground, a rustle of leaves in it (loops)

amb_wind_high.what: Open, hollow wind high above the ground (loops)
amb_wind_high.edits: 40 s of cold arctic wind; the bed treatment

amb_rain_light.edits: 40 s of light rural rain; the bed treatment with its low pass at 6 kHz so the drops stay crisp

amb_rain_heavy.edits: 40 s of heavy rural rain; the bed treatment, low pass at 6 kHz

amb_rain_roof.what: Rain on the roof, heard from inside (loops)
amb_rain_roof.edits: 32 s of rain heard from inside; the bed treatment

amb_surf.edits: 40 s of waves on a shore with waves up close 6 dB under; the bed treatment

amb_open_water.what: Open water from a boat: gentle lapping, no shore (loops)
amb_open_water.edits: 40 s of gentle lake waves lapping at boats, with water lapping a hull 9 dB under; the bed treatment

amb_meadow_day.edits: 40 s of a park, mostly birds, with a quiet spring woodland 6 dB under; the bed treatment with its low pass at 8 kHz, because birdsong lives at 2 to 6 kHz

amb_jungle_day.what: A jungle by day: dense insects, birds and calls (loops)

amb_swamp_day.what: A swamp by day: frogs, insects and still water (loops)
